plugin.name: Proton Mail (external / Bridge)
plugin.description: Unlocks Email → Proton Mail in CPN Panel: Open Proton Mail (https://mail.proton.me), Proton Mail Bridge IMAP/SMTP guidance for local clients, and operator settings. Honest external integration; CPN does not host Proton end-to-end encryption on the server.
plugin.keywords: email, proton, protonmail, webmail, bridge, imap, smtp, external
plugin.author: master3395

features.feature: Enables CPN Email → Proton Mail UI
Proton Mail Bridge host/port guidance for IMAP/SMTP
Operator settings without storing Proton passwords in git

plugin.uninstall_impact: Hides Email → Proton Mail until the plugin is installed again
Removes the Open Proton Mail hub and sidebar entry
Clears the host proton-mail feature flag
Does not delete Proton accounts or Bridge on operator workstations
